IN 2012 REGIME FORCES PREVENTED A GOVERNMENT FIRE TEAM IN ONE CITY FROM RESPONDING TO A FIRE IN A RESIDENTIAL DISTRICT ON THE GROUNDS THAT IT LAY OUTSIDE THEIR CONTROL. THE TEAM DEFIED THEIR COMMANDERS, WENT AND PUT THE FIRE OUT, AND ON THE SAME DAY ESTABLISHED AN EMERGENCY RESPONSE CENTRE TO SERVE ALL SYRIANS. A CREW THAT ANSWERED A CA
